description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TatweejWordsAdapter for displaying a list of TatweejWord objects in an Android app UI, handling item interactions, and visual state changes based on playback status.

classes.name: TatweejWordsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter for displaying TatweejWord items with handling for selection and playback indication.

classes.name: TatweejWordsAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding reference to the TextView for each word item.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's item list with new words and refreshes the view.

methods.name: setPlayingIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the currently playing item and refreshes the view to reflect the change.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder for an item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder and updates UI based on whether the item is playing.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the adapter.
